Contact-order distance conjecture for colored graph representations
2 years old · traced to 2024

Let 
𝐺
G be a graph whose vertices are colored with 
𝑧
z and 
𝑤
w, and let 
𝑖
i be a vertex from which the representation is computed. The contact order is the order describing how the associated level curves approach one another near a boundary singularity. Contact-order distance conjecture. The contact order of the representation computed from vertex 
𝑖
i is twice the path distance from 
𝑖
i to the closest vertex colored 
𝑤
w. The source reports computational evidence for this extension, but does not state a proof or resolution.
